messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doses above 450 mg a day have not been studied"
set: ["doses above 450 mg a day have not been studied", "doses above 400 mg a day have not been studied", "doses higher than 5 mg have not been studied in pediatric patients", "doses above 1.4 mg/kg (or 100 mg) daily have not been studied in pediatric patients", "doses administered for more than 6 days have not been studied", "above 200 mg a day", "100 mg to 450 mg a day", "doses above 1,800 mg a day did not add benefit in studies", "daily doses higher than 240 mg administered in equally divided doses by 15-minute infusion have not been studied", "450 mg", "doses above 100 mg a day do not generally lower blood pressure any further", "total daily doses above 50 mg are not recommended", "doses above 1200 mg a day did not add benefit and caused more side effects", "efficacy beyond 8 weeks has not been systematically studied", "discard after 4 weekly doses have been given", "no additional benefit has been demonstrated with doses above 7.5 mg/day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
